sourceRefs.locator: Introduction and Sobre este lugar: foundation in 578 in honour of the king’s son, the commercial street rising to the palace and church, and the site near Zorita de los Canes.

Introduction, paragraphs 1–3: three furnaces south of the palace, earliest workshop dated from the foundation to the first half of the seventh century, vessels, crucibles and workshop and residential samples.
